results.final_sql: SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='G0483')/sum(line_paid_amount) AS share FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

SELECT p.pc,count(*),round(median(r.payment_date-p.fs),1),round(quantile_cont(r.payment_date-p.fs,0.9),1) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,min(submission_date) fs FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2) p JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code,count(DISTINCT (a.claim_key,a.payer_key)) FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(remit_claim_id) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code='CO' AND a.is_denial_carc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 5

SELECT pc,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE fp),round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE fp)/count(*),2) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,count(*)=1 AND bool_and(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) fp FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc,count(*),sum(rv::INT),sum((NOT cu)::INT),round(coalesce(sum(p),0),2) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) t,bool_or(is_reversal) rv,bool_or(is_current_adjudication) cu,sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) p FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2) WHERE t>=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

SELECT round(coalesce(sum(a.adjustment_amount),0),2) FROM sem.adjustments a WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code='PR' AND a.carc_code='1' AND (a.claim_key,a.payer_key) IN (SELECT (claim_key,payer_key) FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P')

SELECT strftime(m,'%Y-%m'),sum(n),sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5),round(100.0*sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5)/sum(n),1) FROM (SELECT service_month m,referring_npi,count(*) n,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY count(*) DESC,referring_npi) rk FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_date_from>=DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY m ORDER BY 1
SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='87798')/sum(line_paid_amount) AS share FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

SELECT procedure_code,count(*),sum(d::INT),avg(d::INT) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.procedure_code,r.claim_key,r.payer_key,r.is_denied d FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN sem.claim_lines l ON l.claim_key=r.claim_key AND l.payer_key=r.payer_key AND l.is_latest_submission WHERE r.is_current_adjudication) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=20 ORDER BY 4 DESC,1

SELECT b,count(*),sum(d::INT),round(100.0*avg(d::INT),2),coalesce(sum(ch) FILTER (WHERE d),0) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN c.line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE c.line_count::VARCHAR END b,c.charge_amount ch,r.is_denied d FROM sem.claims c JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE c.is_latest_submission AND c.payer_responsibility='P' AND r.is_current_adjudication) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.reference_id,a.payment_date,round(-a.provider_adjustment_amount,2),min(b.payment_date),min(b.payment_date)-a.payment_date FROM sem.provider_adjustments a LEFT JOIN sem.provider_adjustments b ON b.plb_reason_code='FB' AND b.payer_key=a.payer_key AND b.reference_id=a.reference_id AND b.provider_adjustment_amount=-a.provider_adjustment_amount AND b.payment_date>a.payment_date WHERE a.plb_reason_code='FB' AND a.provider_adjustment_amount<0 GROUP BY a.provider_adjustment_id,a.reference_id,a.payment_date,a.provider_adjustment_amount ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT payer_class,round(js,1),round(as_,1),round(as_-js,1) FROM (SELECT payer_class,100*sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month='2026-07-01')/sum(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month='2026-07-01')) OVER () js,100*sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month='2026-08-01')/sum(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month='2026-08-01')) OVER () as_ FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) FILTER (WHERE frequency_code='1') o,min(submission_date) FILTER (WHERE frequency_code='7') r FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING r IS NOT NULL) SELECT count(*),round(avg(r-o),2),count(x.payment_date),round(avg(x.payment_date-o),2),sum(x.paid_amount) FROM c LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims x ON x.claim_key=c.claim_key AND x.payer_key=c.payer_key AND x.is_current_adjudication AND x.payment_date>=c.r

WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key,min(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(DISTINCT v.claim_key),count(DISTINCT v.claim_key) FILTER (WHERE r.paid_amount>0 AND r.payment_date<v.vd),count(DISTINCT v.claim_key) FILTER (WHERE r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date>=v.vd),round(coalesce(sum(r.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE r.is_current_adjudication),0),2) FROM v LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key)
SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount=0 AND NOT is_denied

SELECT pc,count(*),round(avg(dd),1),min(dd),max(dd) FROM (SELECT c.pc,min(r.payment_date)-c.rd dd FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2) c JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.payment_date>=c.rd GROUP BY c.claim_key,c.payer_key,c.pc,c.rd) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key,payer_key HAVING bool_or(is_reversal) AND NOT bool_or(is_current_adjudication))
SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='80307')/sum(line_paid_amount) AS share FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

SELECT pc,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr-fs<=14),round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr-fs<=14)/count(*),1) FROM (SELECT p.*,(SELECT min(payment_date) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key) fr FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,min(submission_date) fs FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2) p WHERE fs BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='G0482')/sum(line_paid_amount) AS share FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT af THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN ok THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END o,count(*),round(sum(p),2) FROM (SELECT c.claim_key,bool_or(r.claim_status_code='4' AND r.payment_date<c.rd) dn,bool_or(r.payment_date>=c.rd) af,bool_or(r.is_current_adjudication AND NOT r.is_denied) ok,coalesce(sum(r.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE r.is_current_adjudication),0) p FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2) c JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY c.claim_key,c.payer_key) WHERE dn GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*),coalesce(round(sum(p),2),0) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) p FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING bool_or(NOT is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied) AND bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied))

SELECT CASE WHEN age<=14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age<=29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END,count(*),sum(ch) FROM (SELECT DATE '2026-08-14'-p.fs age,l.charge_amount ch FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,min(submission_date) fs FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2) p JOIN sem.claims l ON l.claim_key=p.claim_key AND l.payer_key=p.payer_key AND l.is_latest_submission WHERE l.frequency_code<>'8' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT claim_key FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1 HAVING min(submission_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=c.claim_key)
